## My Interactive Visualizations

<div class="gallery-container">

```{r echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
repos <- c(
  "ten-points-animint", "iris-animint-test", "worldbank-animint-test", 
  "kmeans-animint-test", "mc-sample-mean-test", "buffon-needle-test", 
  "rosling-bubbles-test"
)

for(repo in repos){
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo, "/")
  # Forced the direct raw link we just verified
  img_url  <- paste0("[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aakritixyz/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aakritixyz/)", repo, "/main/Capture.PNG")
  
  name <- gsub("-animint|-test", "", repo)
  name <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("-", " ", name))

  cat(paste0('
  <div class="card">
    <a href="', demo_url, '">
      <img src="', img_url, '" alt="', name, '">
    </a>
    <h4>', name, '</h4>
    <p><a href="', demo_url, '">Interactive Demo</a></p>
    <p><a href="[https://github.com/aakritixyz/](https://github.com/aakritixyz/)', repo, '" style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666;">Source Code</a></p>
  </div>
  '))
}
